label: Whatever moves another in a respect is an efficient CAUSE_3 of it in that respect
paraphrase: Open bridge, analyst formulation (attribution deferred): whatever moves another in a respect is an efficient cause of it in that respect. It links the prima via's moving (MovesIn) to the secunda via's efficient causing (EfficientlyCausesIn), which DEF-EFFICIENT-CAUSING keeps distinct; Aristotle's mover mode of cause (the source of change, DEF-ARISTOTELIAN-CAUSE-MODES) motivates it. Occasionalists deny it of creaturely movers.
